tickets.title: Prepare first-year college funding schedule for Lila Pebblefizz
tickets.text: Prepare a first-year college funding schedule for Lila Pebblefizz at Buttonwood Balloon University, mapping the $79,400 estimated cost of attendance against the $12,000 merit scholarship, the $103,800 Lila 529 account at Velvet Acorn Custody, available checking cash, and any remaining gap so the household can see the order and timing of likely funding sources.

tickets.title: Prepare payment plan and short-term borrowing comparison
tickets.text: Prepare a comparison of the Buttonwood Balloon University monthly payment plan, a draw on the $120,000 home equity line, and a limited taxable brokerage sale for any first-year shortfall that remains after the $12,000 merit scholarship and Lila 529 funding for Lila Pebblefizz.

tickets.title: Review concentrated position risk and planning choices
tickets.text:
Assess the concentrated holding, document the risk profile, identify tax-aware diversification options, and prepare recommendations suitable for client review. Include the position size, cost basis status, account registration, liquidity needs, restrictions, and any employer or insider-trading considerations using placeholders where client-specific facts will be added.

For Nadia Pebblefizz's Silver Marmot Robotics stock position worth about $286,000 in a taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody, representing about 22% of household investable assets with an estimated $171,000 unrealized long-term gain, prepare tax-aware sale scenarios that could fund part of Lila Pebblefizz's college shortfall without creating an unnecessarily large concentrated-position reduction at one time.

subTasks.title: Gather position facts and restrictions
subTasks.text: Collect current holding value, percentage of portfolio, account type, estimated cost basis, holding period, dividend or income profile, trading restrictions, blackout windows, and any pledged or restricted-share status for Nadia Pebblefizz's Silver Marmot Robotics position worth about $286,000 in a taxable brokerage account at Velvet Acorn Custody, representing about 22% of household investable assets with an estimated $171,000 unrealized long-term gain.

subTasks.title: Model diversification and tax scenarios
subTasks.text: Compare potential sale, staged sale, charitable gifting, exchange fund, hedging, or hold strategies as applicable. Estimate tax impact, cash flow effect, and portfolio concentration change for each reasonable option, with the additional goal of funding part of Lila Pebblefizz's college shortfall without an unnecessarily large concentrated-position reduction at one time.

subTasks.title: Prepare advisor recommendation summary
subTasks.text: Summarize key risks, viable strategies, tradeoffs, implementation requirements, and open questions for advisor review before client presentation.

tickets.evidence: The agreed follow-up is to prepare the Silver Marmot Robotics stock concentration and tuition funding scenarios by 2025-03-05.

tickets.text:
Confirm the requested beneficiary update, obtain the correct custodian or carrier form, prepare instructions for completion, and track the request through confirmation.
